```{r}
rwanda <- sf::st_read("C:\\Users\\branc\\OneDrive\\Documenti\\Hackathon\\DATA\\GADM\\gadm41_RWA_2.shp")
```

```{r}
rwanda <- rwanda %>% 
  select(NAME_1, NAME_2) %>% 
  rename(
    province = NAME_1,
    district = NAME_2
    ) %>% 
  select(
    province,
    district,
    geometry
  )
```


```{r}
summarized_ir <- agri_prac2019A %>% 
  group_by(district) %>% 
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    area_size = sum(ptot_area_in_sqm),
    irrigation_cost = sum(irrigation_cost_rwf, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% mutate(
    cost_per_sqm = irrigation_cost/area_size
  )

dist_summ <- left_join(summarized_ir, rwanda, by = "district") %>% 
  select(-province)

dist_summ <- sf::st_as_sf(dist_summ)
```


```{r}
p <- irr_rainfall %>% 
  dplyr::filter(year == 2019, season == "A") %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(district) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(rainfall = sum(rainfall_mm)) %>% 
  left_join(as.data.frame(dist_summ, by = "district"))%>% 
  st_as_sf()

```
